verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a domain registrar; evidence covers WHOIS privacy, domain deletion/grace-deletion, and API/MCP domain management, but there is no documentation of data retention policies, account/data deletion controls, or export/erasure mechanisms for AI-native usage such as MCP query logs or API interaction data. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy, user-facing data deletion/export controls, any statement on how AI/MCP interaction data is stored or purged.
